summary: Cybin Inc. (d/b/a Helus Pharma) filed a Form 6-K containing a management information circular, form of proxy, and notice of its annual general and special meeting scheduled for September 22, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine items: receiving audited financials, appointing Zeifmans LLP as auditor, setting board size at eight, electing directors, and a proposal to change the corporate name to Helus Pharma Inc. No special-situation event such as acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed; the filing is a routine shareholder meeting notice and proxy circular.
